query: What satisfaction and complaint themes appear in Yelp reviews?

per_column.name: food_quality_rating
per_column.rationale: Food quality is a core dimension along which diners express satisfaction or complaint; it is an aspect OF the review's satisfaction/complaint content.

per_column.name: service_staff_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Service/staff experience is a constitutive facet of restaurant satisfaction and complaint themes.

per_column.name: service_failure_type
per_column.rationale: This is a sub-facet within the service dimension, categorizing specific complaint modes; it is a part-of the complaint side of the concept, though it overlaps heavily with service_staff_sentiment's negative pole.

per_column.name: atmosphere_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Atmosphere/ambiance is a distinct aspect of the dining experience along which satisfaction/complaint is expressed.

judge.rationale: All four columns are genuine part-of facets of the review satisfaction/complaint concept (food, service, atmosphere) rather than external predictors or causes, so the meronymy claim holds. However, mutual exclusivity is weakened: service_staff_sentiment and service_failure_type both decompose the SAME service dimension, with the failure-type column essentially elaborating the negative pole of the sentiment column — these overlap rather than carving non-overlapping aspects, and the concept ends up double-weighted toward service. Exhaustiveness is moderate: food, service, and atmosphere are covered, but other well-established satisfaction/complaint facets (price/value, cleanliness/hygiene, wait time/reservation, portion size, order accuracy beyond service) are absent, leaving significant constitutive aspects uncovered.
